from: September book, night 9 (He Will Show the Way)
p1: Long ago, people walked everywhere on dusty, rocky paths. A traveler needed someone who knew the way.
King Solomon wrote, “Trust in the Lord with all your heart. Do not lean on your own understanding.” The Lord knows so much more than we do.
Solomon said, “In all your ways remember Him. He will show you your paths.”
p2: The Lord is like a guide who knows every path. He will never get lost. The Lord is Jesus, and He said, “I am the way.”
When you are not sure what to do, you can pray. Jesus will show you the way. You can trust Him with all your heart.
old: A wise man named Solomon wrote down lots of good advice to help us live happy lives. We call his sayings Proverbs. One of the very best is about trusting Heavenly Father.
“Trust in Heavenly Father with ALL your heart,” Solomon wrote. “Don’t try to figure everything out by yourself.”
Sometimes we don’t know which way to go or what to do. That’s okay! Solomon said, “Ask Heavenly Father, and He will show you the right path.”
It’s like walking with someone who knows the way. We don’t have to see the whole road — we just hold His hand and take the next step.
When you trust Heavenly Father with your whole heart, He leads you on good paths, step by step. You can trust Him, even when you can’t see what’s ahead.
